description: Shared Rust/WASM vector for the v1 device-side context checks (#296). Each case patches base_context (keys are dotted JSON paths; a null value writes an explicit null), seals it to the fixed device, and decrypts it as the device. A device refuses a context whose action.capabilities or action.scope is non-null (any JSON value, including [], {}, "", 0 and false), checked first, or whose shown risk is lower than action.risk (a hidden downgrade). A raised or equal context risk passes. Expected values are written by hand from docs/contract.md §Device-side context checks; never regenerate them from program output. expected_error is the exact refusal text, which the decrypt error contains.
